استعطيا (form X)
# اِسْتَعْطَيَا (istaʕṭayā) /is.taʕ.tˤa.jaː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِسْتَعْطَى (istaʕṭā)
# اُسْتُعْطِيَا (ustuʕṭiyā) /us.tuʕ.tˤi.jaː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِسْتَعْطَى (istaʕṭā)
# اِسْتَعْطِيَا (istaʕṭiyā) /is.taʕ.tˤi.jaː/: second-person dual imperative of اِسْتَعْطَى (istaʕṭā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
